chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya and Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Abdullah ibn Ja‘far, from al-Hasan ibn Zarif and Ali ibn Muhammad, from Salih ibn Abi Hammad, from Bakr ibn Salih, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Salim, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:

My father said to Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari: “I have a need from you, so when it is easy for you, let me be alone with you so I may ask you about it.” Jabir said to him: “Whichever time you prefer.” So he was alone with him on one of the days, and he said to him: “O Jabir, inform me about the Tablet that you saw in the hand of my mother Fatimah عليها السلام, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, and what my mother told you was written in that Tablet.”

Jabir said: “I bear witness by Allah that I entered upon your mother Fatimah عليها السلام during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, and I congratulated her on the birth of al-Husayn. I saw in her hands a green Tablet, which I thought was of emerald, and I saw in it white writing resembling the color of the sun. So I said to her: ‘May my father and mother be ransomed for you, O daughter of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, what is this Tablet?’ She said: ‘This is a Tablet that Allah gifted to His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله. In it are the name of my father, the name of my husband, the names of my two sons, and the names of the awsiya’ from my descendants, and my father gave it to me to give me glad tidings by that.’”

Jabir said: “Then your mother Fatimah عليها السلام gave it to me, so I read it and copied it.” So my father said to him: “Would you, O Jabir, show it to me?” He said: “Yes.” So my father went with him to the house of Jabir, and he brought out a parchment. He said: “O Jabir, look into your writing so that I may read to you.” Jabir looked into the copy and my father read it, and not a single letter differed from another letter.
Then Jabir said: “So I bear witness by Allah that I saw it written in the Tablet exactly like this:”

“In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful. This is a writing from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise, to Muhammad, His Prophet, His Light, His envoy, His veil, and His guide. The Trustworthy Spirit descended with it from the Lord of the worlds. Magnify, O Muhammad, My names, be grateful for My blessings, and do not deny My favors. Indeed I am Allah; there is no god except Me, the breaker of the tyrants, the one who gives victory to the oppressed, and the judge of the religion.”

“Indeed I am Allah; there is no god except Me. So whoever hopes for other than My grace or fears other than My justice, I will punish him with a punishment with which I punish no one from the worlds. So worship Me alone, and upon Me place your trust. I have not sent any Prophet whose days were completed and whose term ended except that I appointed for him a wasi, and indeed I preferred you over the Prophets, and I preferred your wasi over the awsiya’, and I honored you with your two lion-cubs and your two grandsons, Hasan and Husayn.”

“So I made Hasan the معدن of My knowledge after the end of his father’s term, and I made Husayn the keeper of My revelation. I honored him with shahadah and sealed for him felicity. Thus he is the best of those martyred and the highest of the martyrs in rank. I placed My complete word with him, and My conclusive proof with him.”

“By his progeny I reward and punish. The first of them is Ali, the chief of the worshippers and the adornment of My past friends, and his son, the likeness of his grandfather al-Mahmud, Muhammad, the splitter open of My knowledge and the mine of My wisdom.”

“Those who doubt regarding Ja‘far will perish. Whoever rejects him is like one who rejects Me. The word from Me has become true: I shall surely honor the abode of Ja‘far, and I shall surely delight him regarding his Shi‘ah, his helpers, and his friends. After him, Musa will face a blind, dark tribulation, because the thread of My obligation does not break and My proof does not remain hidden.”

“And indeed My friends will be given to drink from the fullest cup. Whoever denies one of them has denied My blessing, and whoever alters an ayah from My Book has fabricated against Me. Woe to the fabricators and deniers at the end of the term of Musa, My servant, My beloved, and My chosen one, concerning Ali, My wali, My helper, and the one upon whom I place the burdens of Prophethood and test him with undertaking them. An arrogant demon-like one will kill him. He will be buried in the city built by the righteous servant, beside the worst of My creatures.”

“The word from Me has become true: I shall surely gladden him through Muhammad his son, his khalifah after him, and the inheritor of his knowledge. He is the mine of My knowledge, the locus of My secret, and My proof over My creation. No servant believes in him except that I make Paradise his abode, and I grant him intercession regarding seventy of his household, all of whom had deserved the Fire.”

“And I seal felicity for his son Ali, My wali, My helper, the witness among My creation, and My trustee over My revelation. From him I bring forth the caller to My way and the keeper of My knowledge, al-Hasan, and I complete that with his son Muhammad, a mercy to the worlds. Upon him are the perfection of Musa, the splendor of Isa, and the patience of Ayyub.”

“Then My friends will be humiliated in his time, and their heads will be passed around as gifts just as the heads of the Turks and Daylam are passed around. They will be killed and burned, and they will be fearful, terrified, and trembling. The earth will be dyed with their blood, and wailing and lamentation will spread among their women. Those truly are My friends. By them I repel every blind, dark tribulation; by them I uncover earthquakes and remove burdens and shackles. Those are the ones upon whom are blessings from their Lord and mercy, and those are the rightly guided.”
Abd al-Rahman ibn Salim said: Abu Basir said, “If you were not to hear in your lifetime except this hadith, it would suffice you. So preserve it, except from its أهل.”

key_terms.أَوْلِيَائِي: My friends; those under divine loyalty and support

ai.seo_question: What does the Hadith of the Tablet in al-Kafi say about the names and status of the twelve Imams?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates the report of the Tablet seen by Jabir in the hand of Fatimah عليها السلام, containing a divine text naming the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله and the line of the Imams from his family. It is a foundational creedal narration in Shia tradition concerning Imamate, divine proof, wilayah, and the trials that befall the awliya’ of Allah. It also connects belief in the Imams with divine guidance, intercession, and salvation.
